integrity: Proof covers every integer n>=4; standalone exhaustive direct signature and deletion checks cover n=4,...,9. Same-model scientific review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary open-neighborhood locating-dominating sets of K_(n,n) with the perfect matching deleted, n>=4; it does not concern total, identifying or complement-graph codes. Novelty remains subject to unindexed/independent literature verification.
title: Locating-domination and all minimal codes in matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs
